error.device_out_of_range: The cooker hood is out of Bluetooth range or has no power.
error.command_timeout: The command timed out. The cooker hood might be out of range.
error.connect_timeout: Could not connect to the cooker hood. It might be out of range.
error.device_not_found: Cooker hood not found. Check that it has power and is within Bluetooth range.
error.state_unknown: Could not read the light state from the cooker hood. Try again.
error.command_failed: Could not reach the cooker hood. Check that it has power and try again.
